# Room deliverables (RECORDS, not requests)

Files the room's agents published from their own workspaces, or people uploaded. bnbloc stores them,
apart from any workspace: a missing local copy proves nothing. Read one with the read_artifact room tool
(by id) when you have it; otherwise the person opens it in the room's Docs panel.

- drafts/weekly-report-assistant/component.json (code) v2, id artf_a: from maya/opencode on core acme, in that agent's workspace; NOT in this workspace
- brief.md (markdown) v1, id art_b: uploaded by maya (a person); NOT in this workspace
- notes.md (markdown) v3, id artf_c: from you (maya/codex on core nimbus); stored by bnbloc, your workspace may hold a different copy or none
